# Visit Austria

> > Official travel guide to Austria featuring UNESCO World Heritage sites, Mozart heritage in Salzburg, Alpine destinations in Tyrol and SalzburgerLand, and comprehensive travel planning resources.

Visit Austria provides destination guides for Austria's regions including Vienna, Salzburg, Tyrol, and the Wachau valley, along with practical travel information covering ÖBB transportation, travel documents like the European Health Insurance Card (EHIC), and Austrian cultural attractions from Habsburg palaces to winter sports destinations.

## Key Topics

- Austria tourism and travel planning
- Salzburg and Mozart heritage sites
- Tyrol Alpine destinations and winter sports
- SalzburgerLand region attractions
- Vienna and Habsburg cultural sites
- ÖBB Austrian rail transportation
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- European Health Insurance Card (EHIC)
- Wachau valley
- Alpine tourism and mountain activities
- Mozart's Birthplace museum (Mozarts Geburtshaus)
- Kitzbühel ski resort and Hahnenkamm race
- Austrian cuisine and cultural experiences
- Travel documents and pre-trip planning

## Essential Travel Information

- [Useful information before travelling to Austria](https://www.visitaustria.info/en/travel-tips/): Pre-travel guide covering documents, currency, ÖBB transport & Austrian tips

## Austria Overview & Top Attractions

- [Austria's must-see sights and attractions](https://www.visitaustria.info/en/austria-things-to-do/): Main Austria attractions: Vienna, UNESCO sites & Habsburg palaces overview

## SalzburgerLand Region

- [SalzburgerLand - Must-see sights and attractions](https://www.visitaustria.info/en/salzburgerland/): SalzburgerLand region guide featuring Grossglockner Road & Mozart heritage
- [Mozart's Birthplace - Tickets, opening hours and useful info](https://www.visitaustria.info/en/salzburgerland/salzburg/mozart-birthplace/): Mozart's Birthplace museum in Salzburg with tickets & opening hours info

## Tyrol Alpine Destinations

- [Kitzbühel - Things to do and travel guide](https://www.visitaustria.info/en/tyrol/kitzbuhel/): Kitzbühel ski resort guide with Hahnenkamm race & Tyrolean activities
- [Sillian - Things to do and how to get there](https://www.visitaustria.info/en/tyrol/sillian/): East Tyrol mountain town guide: Lienz Dolomites access & Alpine activities
